BiblicalUsage: Jesharelah is an Israelite, a son of Asaph, a musician of the temple. In 1 Chronicles 25:14, The seventh to Jesharelah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jesharelah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
